# 5-Day Budget Trip: Madrid to Lisbon for 2 Adults

A low-cost city break is very doable under **EUR 900 total** by using bus travel, one budget hotel/apartment stay, and a mix of free viewpoints, walking areas, and low-cost food stops.

## Budget Plan and Cost Breakdown

| Item | Estimated Cost |
|---|---:|
| Round-trip transport Madrid ↔ Lisbon | EUR 70–140 |
| Lodging, 4 nights | EUR 320–520 |
| Food and drinks | EUR 220–300 |
| Local transport | EUR 25–45 |
| Activities and entries | EUR 40–80 |
| Buffer for small extras | EUR 50–80 |
| **Estimated total** | **EUR 725–1,165** |

To stay under **EUR 900**, aim for:
- **Bus instead of flight**
- **Budget stay at EUR 80–120/night total for 2 adults**
- **Mostly free sightseeing**
- **One or two paid attractions only**

## 5-Day Madrid to Lisbon Itinerary

### Day 1: Madrid to Lisbon, easy arrival day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Depart Madrid by overnight or early-day bus to keep costs down.
- **Afternoon:** Check in, rest, then walk around **Baixa** and **Rossio**.
- **Food:** Budget lunch at a local café; dinner with simple petiscos or grilled chicken.
- **Estimated cost:** Transport EUR 35–70 total for 2; lodging EUR 80–120.

### Day 2: Historic Lisbon on foot
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Explore **Alfama** and the cathedral area; free neighborhood wandering.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **Miradouro de Santa Luzia** and nearby viewpoints.
- **Food:** Cheap bakery breakfast, then a supermarket picnic or lunch menu.
- **Estimated cost:** Local transit EUR 6–10; food EUR 40–55; lodging EUR 80–120.

### Day 3: Belém and riverfront day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Go to **Belém** for the riverside monuments and gardens.
- **Afternoon:** See the exterior of **Jerónimos Monastery** and the **Belém Tower** area; choose one paid entry only if desired.
- **Food:** Share a **pastel de nata** stop and keep lunch casual.
- **Estimated cost:** Transit EUR 6–10; optional entry EUR 10–18; food EUR 40–60; lodging EUR 80–120.

### Day 4: Low-cost culture and viewpoints
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- **Morning:** Ride the tram or walk through **Chiado** and **Bairro Alto**.
- **Afternoon:** Visit a free museum day if available, or relax in a park like **Eduardo VII**.
- **Food:** Midday set menu or grocery-store meal to protect the budget.
- **Estimated cost:** Local transit EUR 6–10; food EUR 40–55; lodging EUR 80–120.

### Day 5: Final stroll and return to Madrid
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/car-front.svg
- **Morning:** Last walk through **Praça do Comércio** and the riverfront.
- **Afternoon:** Return to Madrid by bus.
- **Food:** Light breakfast and one simple meal before departure.
- **Estimated cost:** Return transport included in trip total; food EUR 20–35.

## Best Low-Cost Trip Mix

- **Free activities**
  - Walking the old districts: **Alfama, Baixa, Chiado**
  - Viewpoints: **Santa Luzia**, city terraces, riverfront promenades
  - Public squares, parks, and waterfront time
- **Low-cost activities**
  - One tram ride or funicular
  - One museum or monument entry
  - One food stop for pastel de nata or a simple seafood lunch
- **Money-saving choices**
  - Stay near a metro or central bus line
  - Eat breakfast from a bakery or supermarket
  - Use a 24-hour transit pass only if you expect multiple rides

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Find buses] https://www.flixbus.com
Action: [Button: Compare stays] https://www.booking.com
Action: [Button: Lisbon transit info] https://www.metrolisboa.pt

## Sources

- Lisbon transport and visitor info: https://www.visitlisboa.com/
- Lisbon Metro: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/
- Long-distance bus options: https://www.flixbus.com/
- Budget stay comparison: https://www.booking.com/
